about: What fireflies.json reads into. The file is written by hand in the shape of a transcript's sentences in Fireflies's API (index, speaker_name, text, start_time, end_time), the times in seconds. It is not a downloaded file: replace it with a real one when one is at hand.

turns.text: Good morning. Shall we start with the budget?
Yes. Travel is ten percent over plan.
Can we move the offsite to May?
May works, and the venue holds forty people.
Then book it. Research & design present first.
Agreed. I will send the notes today.
